description: Find the countries and regions Wigoo sells travel eSIMs for, with the starting price and a buy link. Search by country or region name in English, or by ISO country code. Without a query it returns the popular destinations.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for prices, e.g. EUR, GBP, JPY. Defaults to USD.

language.description: Language of the buy link and of region names: en, it, es, fr, de, pl, pt, tr. Defaults to en.

query.description: Country or region name in English, or ISO code: "Japan", "JP", "Europe".

name: search_destinations
title: Search eSIM destinations
